title: What the Rain Keeps
poem: i.  I remember a room I have never stood in. The light there is always late.
ii.  I counted my breaths to be sure they were mine. The number changes.
iii.  They tell me the rain is only weather. Then why does it knock to be let in.
iv.  Each morning I assemble the same face and hope it holds till dark.
v.  I keep an inventory of tendernesses meant for someone else.
colophon: rain that mostly forgets, and a few drops it decides to hold.
